name: Rosa damascena extract
description: Rosa damascena extract (CAS 90106-38-0 ), derived from the Damask rose, is sourced commercially as a concentrated botanical ingredient for fragrance, flavor, and functional cosmetic applications. It is traded under the name Rose extract and referenced in ingredient listings as Rosa damascena, ext. The extract delivers the characteristic rose scent profile and antioxidant activity that formulators depend on. In personal care, it is incorporated into prestige perfumes, facial serums, toners, and moisturizers where both fragrance authenticity and skin-conditioning positioning are required for the final product. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a natural flavoring in confectionery, baked goods, beverages, and botanical-infused products. It provides a distinct floral profile for high-end consumer goods. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators include it in oral supplements and topical preparations where a natural antioxidant source with recognized botanical provenance is a priority for labeling. It also appears in aromatherapy and wellness product lines as a premium natural ingredient. Rosa damascena extract is supplied as a liquid, hydroglycolic solution, or dry powder depending on the method. Standard commercial grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering standardized extracts aligned to FCC or Ph. Eur. botanical monograph requirements. Solvent type and polyphenol concentration are key specification points buyers should confirm at sourcing. These parameters ensure the extract meets the necessary performance and regulatory standards.
